title: Crispy Fritters with Indian Spices
description: A delicious and crunchy snack made with crispy fritters and aromatic indian spices. Perfect for a quick bite.

ingredients.name: Beans
ingredients.notes: any type of beans, such as black beans or chickpeas

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.notes: any neutral-tasting oil, such as vegetable or canola oil

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the crispy fritters to the skillet and fry until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the fritters from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and heat over medium heat.
Add the Indian spice blend and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beans to the skillet and cook until heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the fritters back to the skillet and stir to combine with the beans and spice blend.
Season with salt to taste, if desired.
